test_title: PYST 31: Selection Post (Matric Level) - General Intelligence (Held On 3 Feb 2022 Shift 2)
subject: reasoning
question: In a certain code language, ‘JOVIAL’ is written as ‘QIECZF’ and ‘TENDER’ is written as ‘GYMXVL’. How will ‘STRING’ be written in that language?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/2cbc5c097aeb98a48b72ad50b9d4e29b952906e3f76fa5d128ba82d4b9289f2b.png] 

The logic follows here is :-

**First, Third, Fifth letters of word are coded as opposite letter.**

**Code of Second, Fourth, Sixth letters of word = **Position value of that letters** - 6.**

‘JOVIAL’ is written as ‘QIECZF’.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/25fbb5f64e14dd5c314ab0620276ad4c9dc68ec7dc27d685b998d007c702d154.png] 

And

‘TENDER’ is written as ‘GYMXVL’.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/800aafaf0bccd695a48f89de67baf3f7813362cf696269facbe9dbf506445109.png] 

Similarly,

‘STRING’ will be written as :

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/60a5211afadee60ab5bf827fed729f2a3c64855211eb75762808dffe30319486.png] 

Hence, the correct answer is **"HNICMA".**
